title: Yard regulations

blocks.html: For permitted residential uses, the provisions of Section 23-311 (Permitted obstructions in all yards, courts and open areas) shall apply with the following modifications:
blocks.plainText: For permitted residential uses, the provisions of Section 23-311 (Permitted obstructions in all yards, courts and open areas) shall apply with the following modifications:

blocks.html: (a)    open accessory off-street parking spaces shall not be located within a front yard unless such spaces are located in a permitted side lot ribbon;
blocks.plainText: (a) open accessory off-street parking spaces shall not be located within a front yard unless such spaces are located in a permitted side lot ribbon;

blocks.html: (b)    three-foot overhangs in a required front yard in R4 or R5 Districts shall not be permitted.
blocks.plainText: (b) three-foot overhangs in a required front yard in R4 or R5 Districts shall not be permitted.

blocks.html: In addition, the rear yard requirements in paragraph (a)(1) of Section 23-342 (Rear yard requirements) shall apply to all buildings.
blocks.plainText: In addition, the rear yard requirements in paragraph (a)(1) of Section 23-342 (Rear yard requirements) shall apply to all buildings.

subsections.label: (a)
subsections.plainText: (a) open accessory off-street parking spaces shall not be located within a front yard unless such spaces are located in a permitted side lot ribbon;

subsections.label: (b)
subsections.plainText: (b) three-foot overhangs in a required front yard in R4 or R5 Districts shall not be permitted.
